[[Vanquish]] the [[Bukdek Byway]]. 

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Clear at least 25 enemies in the Bukdek Byway near [[Kaineng City]] {{sic|'near Kaineng City' instead of 'in Kaineng City' or 'near Kaineng Center'}} in [[hard mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 150 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].

== Dialogues ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; [[Zaishen Vanquish]]
: ''"Clear at least 25 enemies in the Bukdek Byway near Kaineng City {{sic|'near Kaineng City' instead of 'in Kaineng City' or 'near Kaineng Center'}} in hard mode."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = There are still threats that remain. Return when you have slain all of the foes that await you at your destination.}}

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Zehnchu
: ''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

== Notes ==

{{bug|Despite the objective description, this quest does not require killing 25 foes, but requires [[vanquish]]ing the area. The quest is still completed if the area is vanquished by killing less than 25 foes. See [[Bukdek Byway#Notes]] for details on 0-kill or low-count vanquishes.}}
